about: Cintre is a clothing concept boutique on Chekka Main Road. Browse its photographed outfits and individual collection references, save inspiration and contact the team to confirm the details of your selection.
hours: Confirm current shop hours with the team

products.name: Striped Asymmetric Shirt
products.description: A pale vertically striped shirt with a pointed asymmetric hem, shown with grey trousers. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Burgundy Zip Jacket
products.description: A dark burgundy zip-front jacket with a shaped waist and structured seams. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Checked Belted Jacket
products.description: A grey checked jacket with a belt at the waist, shown in a side and back styling view. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Pleated Grey Skirt
products.description: A grey pleated short skirt styled with a burgundy jacket and boots. This reference is for the skirt; ask about other styling items separately. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Burgundy V-Neck Top
products.description: A fitted burgundy long-sleeved V-neck top, shown with wide grey trousers. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Olive Padded Jacket
products.description: A short olive padded-looking jacket with a high collar and horizontal panel seams. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Green Grey Zip Knit
products.description: A zip-front knit with broad green and grey horizontal stripes and a high collar. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Dark Fitted Shirt
products.description: A dark fitted collared shirt shown with a short denim skirt in a collection styling image. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Striped Button Cardigan
products.description: A brown and pale striped button-front cardigan, styled with a brown skirt. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.

products.name: Burgundy Tall Boots
products.description: Tall burgundy boots shown both as a handheld reference and styled with a skirt. Ask the team to confirm the exact length and current sizes. Price, availability, sizing and the exact photographed reference need confirmation with the shop.
